items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And he’s such a — I really love that guy.

ctx.x: He walked out on that stage and the whole audience erupted into applause. It was great. And he’s such a — I really love that guy. He’s so vital and I mean I don’t know how old he is—
